notablePrerequisites: Aphetto Alchemist does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Aphetto Alchemist by tapping it, targeting itself.
Ertha Jo's second ability triggers, copying Aphetto Alchemist's ability, targeting any other creature or artifact.
Resolve both Aphetto Alchemist abilities, untapping it and the other targeted creature or artifact.
Repeat.
